entries.speaker: Metaverse Navigator
entries.en: A new area has been confirmed.[n]Updating guidance information.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And you all happen to know him[n]already?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Is there anybody you don't know?
entries.uk: Є хтось, кого ви не знаєте?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: ...but this one smells a bit different from[n]the others.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Aw, I guess I shouldn't be picky.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I'm going to move on further.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Are you guys doing the same?

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: Whether or not you do, let me know if[n]you find any more flowers.
entries.uk: Хай так чи інак, дайте знати, якщо[n]знайдете ще квіти.

entries.speaker: Jose
entries.en: I'll reward you well for them.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It would be much odder if the Metaverse[n]were as logical as the real world is.
entries.uk: Було б значно дивніше, якби Метавсесвіт[n]був такий самий логічний, як реальний світ.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Be careful if you're going any further,[n]all right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm getting all sorts of strange readings—[n]Shadows too.
entries.uk: Я отримую всілякі дивні показники —[n]і Тіні теж.
